capabilities: Count words, characters and sentences in selected text
Show live selected-text counts in the status bar
Exclude paths, code, comments, headings and custom words from counts
Override exclusions per note via frontmatter or inline comments
View, copy and track past counts as history
extras: Full documentation is hosted on an external Documentation Hub rather than the README. Mobile is untested; the ribbon button and status bar integration are not available on Obsidian Mobile.
problem: Obsidian's built-in word count only reports whole-note statistics and cannot count or analyze just the selected text with fine-grained exclusions.
summary: Counts words, characters and sentences in selected text across all view modes and Canvas cards, with exclusion rules and count history.
